name: 10530 · Hartsdale, NY
findings: ZIP 10530 (Hartsdale) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10530 (Hartsdale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10530 (Hartsdale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
